parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ tracker_id: $vars.TRACKER_ID, mentions: $input.all().map(item => ({ source_channel: 'rss', source_url: item.json.link || item.json.guid, source_domain: (item.json.link || '').replace(/https?:\/\/([^/]+).*/, '$1'), author_name: item.json.author || item.json.creator, content_text: ((item.json.title || '') + '. ' + (item.json.summary || item.json.content || '')).slice(0, 2000), published_at: item.json.pubDate || item.json.date, keywords_matched: $vars.TRACKER_KEYWORDS.split(','), raw_payload: { feed: $vars.RSS_FEED_URL } })) }) }}

meta.notes: One workflow instance per RSS feed URL per tracker. Set: RSS_FEED_URL, API_BASE_URL, API_TOKEN, TRACKER_ID, TRACKER_KEYWORDS. Duplicate this workflow for each feed URL.
